subject: Pilot: Microfleet (EV) + Keyless Handoff for Exec Offsite
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Diego Rojas <diego@bluelinecs.com>; ops@bluelinecs.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Microfleet pilot for June 21-23 offsite — requirements and ask

Hi Diego / BlueLine team,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We have a small executive offsite at The Grand Hall (SJC) June 21–23 and want to run a microfleet pilot rather than rely solely on rideshare. High-level asks: 

- 8 electric vehicles (premium sedans) staged in a single offsite parking hub adjacent to the venue.
- Keyless handoff: execs should be able to unlock a car via a short-lived PIN or mobile app; minimal in-person key transfer.
- Concierge shuttle window for brief curb pickups (3 windows per day: AM arrival, midday transfers, evening departures).
- On-demand short trips (within 10 miles) for small groups; priority routing for execs.
- One on-site BlueLine concierge 7:30am–9:30pm each day plus a backup floater.
- Insurance and proof of commercial coverage for EVs (we will need the cer on file).

Can you share a quick SOW and rate card for: vehicle day rates, concierge hourly, per-trip pricing for on-demand requests, and any minimum staffing requirements? Also confirm whether you can integrate a telematics/keyless partner (we prefer Samsync) or if BlueLine has an in-house solution.

Attaching a rough site map and anticipated arrival windows so you can propose staging. If possible we need a pricing + SOW draft by Wed EOD (June 9) so procurement can review.

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Program Lead, Events & Offsites | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Diego Rojas <diego@bluelinecs.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@bluelinecs.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microfleet pilot for June 21-23 offsite — requirements and ask

Alex — thanks, this is great detail. We can support the pilot. Summary of what we can provide and next steps: 

- Vehicles: 8x Tesla Model 3+ or EQS class (we'll propose mix based on availability). Day rate includes 150 miles/day; excess at $0.75/mile.
- Keyless handoff: we integrate Samsync (certificate-based short-lived PINs) — we will coordinate API keys and install the Samsync gateway in each vehicle prior to deployment.
- Concierge staffing: 1 dedicated onsite concierge 07:30–21:30, 1 floater on-call. Concierge handles staging, pickups, and simple troubleshooting.
- Curb pickup windows: we can staff 3 windows/day as requested; will need permission from venue for temporary curb staging (they typically require a permit).
- Insurance: attaching our commercial policy (vendor_insurance_certificate.pdf).

Open questions for you: 
1) Do you want contactless waiver or a signed rider agreement at check-out? We recommend a touchless waiver link during unlock.
2) Charging: do you want us to supply mobile Level 2 chargers or coordinate with venue-owned L2s? Mobile chargers incur $150/day each; we recommend 2 chargers for 8 vehicles for turnover.

I attached a SOW draft and rate sheet (blueline_sow_draft.docx). If that looks good I can update and prepare a DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Diego

--
Diego Rojas
Head of Corporate Logistics | BlueLine Car Services LLC
diego@bluelinecs.com | +1 303-555-0091
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Diego Rojas <diego@bluelinecs.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microfleet pilot for June 21-23 offsite — requirements and ask

Diego — quick follow-ups from our side after reviewing the SOW: 

- Please include spare vehicle contingency: 1 spare EV onsite each morning (rotation at 6am if needed).
- We will need mobile chargers as you recommended — please price 2 mobile L2 units and a daily energy allowance for 8 cars.
- Concierge scope: beyond staging, concierge must handle guest onboarding (help with PIN/app) and basic sanitation between executive shifts.
- Venue parking permits: I'll loop in venue but need BlueLine to send proof of liability naming Redwood Inference as an additional insured for the permit app.

Alex — procurement will want a final rate card + SOW by Wed EOD. Marcus, please confirm if we need any additional compliance docs (fleet telematics data retention, driver background checks).

Thanks, Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Events Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0144
From: ops@bluelinecs.com <ops@bluelinecs.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: diego@bluelinecs.com, venue-parking@grandhall.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microfleet pilot for June 21-23 offsite — requirements and ask

Marissa / Alex —

Thanks — we can add 1 spare EV on site each morning and will include 2x mobile L2 chargers in the final quote. Pricing highlights: vehicle day rate $480/day (includes 150 miles), spare vehicle standby $300/day (reduced rate), mobile charger $150/day each, concierge $48/hr, on-demand per-trip $35 base + $2.50/mile.

About data and compliance: 
- Telematics: Samsync stores telemetry for 30 days by default; if Redwood needs a different retention window we can discuss a custom SLA.
- Background checks: all drivers are screened annually; we will include driver roster and screening certs in the packet.
- Additional insured / permit: attached certificate will name Redwood Inference as additional insured for the duration of the event once DocuSign is complete.

Venue (cc'd): can you confirm curb staging rules and where we should plan to set the hub? We propose Lot C (adjacent loading dock) as it has a covered staging area and secondary access.

Next steps: we will update the SOW with the spare EV, chargers, and hourly concierge and send the DocuSign by EOD Wed.

Regards,
BlueLine Ops

Attachments: blueline_sow_draft.docx, vendor_insurance_certificate.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Diego Rojas <diego@bluelinecs.com>, ops@bluelinecs.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, venue-parking@grandhall.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microfleet pilot for June 21-23 offsite — requirements and ask

Diego / BlueLine Ops — this looks good, thank you. Two quick clarifications before we finalize: 

1) Samsync integration: procurement needs a short note confirming API keys will be isolated to this event and that telematics data will not be used for any marketing or analytics outside incident investigation. Can you add that to the SOW?
2) Energy allowance: please include a not-to-exceed kWh allowance per vehicle per day and charge rate for excess.

If you can include those items and send the final SOW + rate card + DocuSign link, we'll route to procurement and legal first thing Thu. Once signed we will provide the final attendee arrival list and the parking permit contact.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Program Lead, Events & Offsites | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
